workProcess.subtitle: We make designing your space simple, accessible, and completely online.

step1.title: Schedule your session
step1.description: Choose the day and time that best suits you. Our team will accompany you from the first call to the final design.

step2.title: Tell us about your style
step2.description: During the session, we analyze your ideas, needs, and budget. We create a personalized proposal based on your preferences and objectives.

step3.title: Receive your design
step3.description: Get your visual proposal with floor plans, color palette, and furniture suggestions. We'll fine-tune the details until we achieve the ideal space for you.

faq.title: Get started with our simple pricing plan
faq.subtitle: Choose the package that best suits your project and transform your space with professional online design advice.

q1.question: Can I schedule more than one design session?
q1.answer: Of course. You can schedule additional sessions based on the progress of your project or if you wish to make adjustments after the initial delivery.

q2.question: Do prices change depending on the time of day or the day of the week?
q2.answer: No. Our plans have fixed and transparent prices, without additional charges for time or day of the week.

q3.question: Can I receive advice on weekends?
q3.answer: Yes. We have limited availability on Saturdays and Sundays, ideal for those who prefer to coordinate their design outside of work hours.

q4.question: What payment methods do you accept?
q4.answer: We accept payments with Mastercard and Visa credit or debit cards.
